messages:
alex: quick sync — customer wants a short POC to validate latency/cost/quality tradeoffs before committing to Dedicated. they expect <150ms p50 for user-facing path, p95 <350ms, and avg per-1k-token cost < $0.90. can we confirm feasibility and what config we should promise?
maya: sounds reasonable to scope. are those numbers for completions only or includes embeddings/rerank?
alex: completions/chat path only (single-turn, ~200-token responses). will run ~10k requests/day during POC.
maya: ok. recommendation: start on Hosted with a pinned 13B quantized variant + autoscale, use continuous batching disabled for low latency, enable prefix KV cache for common prompts. should meet p50 ~80–120ms on gpus we benchmark. p95 depends on burst concurrency — if they need strict p95 SLA, we should propose Dedicated.
nate: pricing q — for 10k req/day @200 tokens -> ~2M tokens/day? wait math: 10k * 200 = 2,000,000 tokens/day. at $0.0004/token that’s $800/day -> ~$24k/mo. we can offer a temporary PO with a capped burn or recommend a small Dedicated commit to reduce unit cost.
joanna: security note — customer requires KMS envelope encryption and SOC2 + access audit logs during POC. Hosted supports customer-managed KMS via BYOK; we need to document key rotation cadence. also they want data retention = 30d.
maya: for evals — propose an automated eval run: 1) 500 prompt seeds from their production samples (anonymized), 2) quality metric = top-1 pass rate on rubric (binary accept/reject), threshold >= 92%, 3) latency and cost measured across 24h window with synthetic steady traffic. sample command: ```bash
redwood-cli eval run --model rdx-13b-q --prompts prompts.json --metrics pass_rate,latency,cost --duration 24h
```
alex: timeline: prep week 1 (insert prompts, KMS setup), run week 2 (24–72h steady run + spot checks), week 3 handoff + exec summary. customer wants acceptance checklist at end.
nate: acceptance checklist draft: ["pass_rate >= 92% on owner-labeled eval set", "p50 <= 150ms", "p95 <= 350ms or fallback plan to Dedicated", "per-1k-token cost <= $0.90", "KMS enabled + audit logs", "no PII in retained prompts"]
joanna: add "security questionnaire answers completed" and confirm DLP scanning for incoming prompts.
alex: can someone put numbers into the POC quote and a short runbook for the AE to send? i'll ping prospect after we have the burn cap options. :thumbsup:
redwood-bot: Created POC ticket RED-2026-719 in JIRA and added checklist template.
maya: i'll draft the runbook + recommended model/config and upload to the POC ticket by EOD today.
alex: perfect — thanks all.
